name: Weasel Second
text: Start of Combat: the units in front of this gain First Bite for this combat.
golden_text: Start of Combat: the units in front of this gain First Bite for this combat.

source.note: First Bite: Quick in this unit's first exchange each combat. Quick: in an exchange this deals its damage first; if that kills, it takes no damage. The library text says 'the unit in front of this'; in the 4-3 brick a back slot has two slots in front, so the prototype gives it to both.
